description: What needs doing today across the Oskivo apps connected to this shop. Call this when the merchant asks "what needs doing today?" or "anything I should worry about?", what is urgent, or for a daily briefing. It calls get_today_list on every approved app in parallel, skips apps that do not expose that tool yet or that error, and returns one list sorted urgent, then attention, then info, plus a per-app summary. Read-only: it never changes anything in the shop. Use min_severity to return only urgent, or urgent and attention, items.

min_severity.description: Lowest severity to include. "urgent" returns only urgent items, "attention" returns urgent and attention items, and "info" (the default) returns everything.

name: get_today_across_apps
title: What needs doing today
